pages.raw_meta: ISG is a global AI-centered technology research and IT advisory firm committed to helping clients achieve operational excellence.
raw_blocks: Take control of what your technology delivers, however fast the market moves
State of Enterprise AI: The AI Value Gap
AI is creating visible operational gains for many enterprises. However, it's not yet consistently producing business and financial value.
Make the right move, with confidence
Sourcing for a changing market

ISG combines decades of deal experience, deep provider knowledge and an AI-first perspective to help you choose partners and negotiate contracts that reflect changing capabilities and costs before outdated terms limit your options.
Understand what your technology should cost

Without a clear view of how your costs, contracts and service quality compare with the market, you may keep paying too much or accepting too little, and ISG’s extensive benchmarking data gives you the evidence to decide where to act.
Get the results you expect from your suppliers

Even a well negotiated contract can fall short if performance slips or risks go unnoticed, so ISG combines supplier management expertise with ongoing oversight to help you address problems early and get the results your business depends on.
Choose providers with a clearer view of the market

As AI reshapes service and software capabilities, relying on familiar names can mean overlooking a better fit, while ISG’s independent research and firsthand market knowledge help you understand your options before making a significant commitment.
Your AI strategy, built for what comes next
Every AI decision now affects performance, competitiveness and the future of the enterprise. By the time you’ve finalised your AI strategy, the market may already have moved on.

ISG brings independent market intelligence, enterprise benchmarks and practical advisory experience to help you decide what matters, where to act and how fast to move. We connect AI market shifts to your strategy, operating model, workforce and economics so you can move earlier, avoid stranded investment and keep your strategy relevant.
Choose where AI matters and make it scale

AI strategy is not a catalogue of use cases, it's the choice of where the enterprise will place its bets, how work will change and what deserves to scale. We help you connect AI ambition to business priorities, select the use cases worth scaling and define the operating model, roadmap and partner strategy to move forward. This gives you a clear portfolio of priorities, a funded path to execution and a practical definition of what success looks like.
Put accountability behind every AI decision

Without clear decision rights and controls, pilots stall, autonomous systems create unmanaged exposure and accountability breaks down. Across use cases, models, agents and workflows, we establish clear ownership, classify risk, design lifecycle controls, monitor performance and create reporting that gives you a usable view of exposure and trust.
Know what AI adoption is doing to your P&L

Without a clear model for spend, savings and performance, you can increase AI investment without knowing whether it is improving the P&L. ISG helps you understand consumption and token economics, set funding priorities, redesign pricing and commercial models and connect increasing autonomy to savings, ROI and business performance so you can fund the right use cases, negotiate from evidence and hold enterprise performance to account.
Redesign work around human and AI strengths

If work is not redesigned, adoption fragments, shadow AI spreads and the benefits of deployment stay trapped in isolated teams. The ISG AI Maturity Index gives you a data-driven baseline across teams and roles. Combined with our workforce and change expertise, it helps you assess how AI will change work and define the skills, role changes and adoption actions needed to move forward. With this foundation in place, adoption is stronger, roles are clearer and your workforce is equipped to work effectively with AI.

raw_blocks: ISG helps you to confront emerging challenges, prepare for new opportunities and reimagine your future.

As a global AI-centered technology research and advisory firm, ISG partners with our clients to determine a future vision, lead rapid change and realize the value of your digital investments at scale. We're more than consultants: we help our clients achieve operational excellence and faster growth.
Contact Us to Learn More
To create an industry-leading, high-growth, information-based services business.
We aspire to be the best in our market, grow both organically and through further acquisitions and be truly information-based by making full use of the valuable data we collect on our engagements.
Operational excellence for commercial and public-sector clients.
We strive to ensure we offer the best solutions to our clients through our extensive services portfolio and the expertise of our consultants.
Founded in 2006 and based in Stamford, Connecticut, ISG employs more than 1,500 digital-ready professionals operating in more than 20 countries .
Watch ISG Ring the Nasdaq Opening Bell

AI is the new frontier, driving unprecedented change and unmatched opportunity. Turning AI investment into real competitive advantage—that’s the ultimate challenge—but it’s a road you don’t have to travel alone. Let ISG be your guide, bringing clarity, expertise and independence to help you cut through complexity, scale AI with confidence and impact, and accelerate growth. It’s time to AI M Higher. Let’s move forward … together.
Our clients are global leaders across 20+ industries, including public sector organizations, service and technology providers, and 75 of the world’s top 100 enterprises.
We don’t just accept difference — we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, clients and communities.

We are thought leaders with the insights and experience to help you avoid pitfalls and make the right moves on your digital journey. When you need unbiased expertise, get in touch with an ISG advisor.

We employ the brightest, most innovative people in the industry to provide world-class solutions to our clients. If you're ready to make a genuinely positive impact for yourself, your company and its clients, view our available positions today.
SEE POSITIONS IN YOUR REGION
We believe in doing our part to make a better future.
ISG is committed to improving ourselves and our communities through our corporate social responsibility (CSR) work.

To honor Earth Day this year, we asked our employees to take action with us. We challenged employees to pick a green action and pledge to incorporate this action in their day-to-day lives. For each employee who pledged, ISG planted a tree in their name!
Inclusion, Diversity, Equity & Awareness

We believe in diversity of people & perspectives, equity in policy, practice & position, and inclusion via power, voice & organizational culture. Our IDEA team works to create initiatives to drive real, continuous change to our culture.

ISG works directly with local charities and businesses to create key relationships between our employees and our local communities. ISG has encouraged employees to volunteer and offers paid monthly leave to allow staff to offer their services.

ISG Women in Digital is dedicated to connecting, educating, empowering and recognizing women as they navigate the changing world and make the most of their digital future. Join our LinkedIn community today.
Our corporate profile, stock information, annual reports, SEC filings, newsroom and more.

raw_blocks: Real-time Benchmarking and Price Intelligence for IT, BPO & Network Services
CONTACT US TO GET STARTED
How AI Is Changing IT Labor Rates and IT Services Economics

The impact of AI on IT labor rates is one of the most common questions facing sourcing leaders, CIOs and service providers. Yet current market evidence suggests AI's most significant economic effect is not on the price of labor but on the amount of labor required to deliver a business outcome.
Know What IT Services Should Cost
ISG ProBenchmark is a real-time price benchmarking and market intelligence platform for IT, BPO and network services.

It helps enterprises and service providers assess whether a proposed or existing transaction is competitively priced, understand the cost of different delivery models and make better commercial decisions.
With ISG ProBenchmark, teams can:
Benchmark proposed solutions against current market price ranges
Monitor existing outsourcing transactions as services and market conditions change
Compare labor mix, automation and delivery assumptions
Benchmark AI-specialized roles and evolving service models
Model the impact of these changes on total contract value
For enterprises , ISG ProBenchmark helps validate pricing and identify opportunities to improve sourcing outcomes.
For service providers , it helps build more competitive proposals based on current market intelligence.
This makes ISG's database the largest of its kind in the industry and a trusted IT benchmarking service provider.
Price monitor your existing outsourcing transactions
Get access to ISG ProBenchmark
Are your IT services market competitive?
Outsourcing contracts become uncompetitive over time, as services are added and COLA clauses kick in
Determining price competitiveness using a tripartite cost benchmark analysis is costly, and typically is performed only once every 12 to 18 months

Ensure contract prices remain competitive over time, given AI, automation and related productivity gains
